summary: Ore Run is a stream described as a tributary of Sullivan Branch in Sullivan County, Pennsylvania, United States. It is roughly long, flows through Davidson Township, and has a low pH and poor water quality. The note also lists the main rock formations and soil associations in the surrounding area.
one_line: Ore Run is a short tributary of Sullivan Branch in Davidson Township, Sullivan County, Pennsylvania, with low pH and poor water quality.
key_facts: Ore Run is a tributary of Sullivan Branch in Sullivan County, Pennsylvania, in the United States.
Ore Run is approximately long, though the note does not state the numeric length.
Ore Run flows through Davidson Township.
The watershed of Ore Run has an area given in the note, but the numeric value is not stated.
Ore Run has a low pH and poor water quality.
The main rock formations in the area of Ore Run are the Huntley Mountain Formation and the Burgoon Sandstone.
The main soil associations in the vicinity of Ore Run are the Deep-Wellsboro-Oquaga association and the Oquaga association.
The note leaves the length and watershed area of Ore Run blank, so those figures are unavailable from this source.
